title: Page 7
content_zh:
“厚，狐狸尾巴露出来了，你就是一心想当掌家的二少奶奶！”
“那也是因为我爱尚仁，才会想嫁他。”甜蜜的笑容漾在她嘴角。她爱他，自然想要嫁他，这很怪吗？干么一副抓到把柄大惊小怪的模样？
“你是爱他的钱！你这个心机超重的女人！”
“你跟他拿的钱，应该比我多吧？”说别人之前，怎都没先反省自己呀！
“呃，我~我不一样。”
结巴了吧！哼，看到她就想到花心的掌尚仁，巴瑞儿气得快抓狂。
起身，她大步走回房，关上门，突然觉得很可笑，一个花心男把他的两个女人丢在同一屋子，两人极尽所能耍幼稚、比得意，而那个“肇事”的男人，却躲在公司不敢回来……说不定他以公事忙为借口，又溜到夜店去狂欢了。
是可忍，孰不可忍。
她再也忍不下去了！
正想打电话给掌尚仁叫他速速回来解决“家中事”，突然，门铃声响了。
第一个跃入她脑内的是，他回来了！他帮夏春静买晚餐回来？！
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
巴瑞儿瞪着门板，深吸一口气，等会儿她开门出去，若是他回来，她一定二话不说马上离开。
用力的开了门，怒气冲冲走到客厅，客厅的人不是他，她心头的怒意消除了一半。
“左金？”
“瑞儿小姐，你……你还没吃晚餐吧，我买了两份，这一份给……”左金一脸尴尬的笑，拿起桌上另一份晚餐正要递给巴瑞儿，夏春静忙不迭从半空中抓回那份。
“这个也是我要吃的。”
“可是，你已经在吃了……”
“我要吃两份才会饱。”夏春静得意的昂高下巴。“尚仁哥知道我食量大吃不胖，他每次都买两人份的餐点给我吃。”
“喔。”左金愣了下。“那，瑞儿小姐，我再去帮你买晚餐。”

“不需要。”“不用了。”两个女人异口同声道。
巴瑞儿瞪了夏春静一眼，跟这女人有默契，实在是三生不幸。这又让她想到她们选择了同一个男人，这种默契，她宁愿不要。
“呃……”后知后觉的左金，似乎闻到一股浓浓的火药味。
“我不想吃。”巴瑞儿淡淡的说，她懒得再战。
“对啊，她不想吃，而且你不是说公司还有事要忙吗？快点回去呀！”
对耶，二少正在和总裁大人及老总裁展开越洋连线大战，火气正旺，万一他发现他这个特助暂时落跑，那把火可能会把他烤成人干。
“呃，瑞儿小姐，那个……”左金欲言又止。
二少为了瑞儿小姐的手工包要在天信设柜一事和两位大人辩得脸红脖子粗，事实上，没有人看好二少的提议，连他这个特助都觉得踢掉德国品牌专卖手工包的企画不太妥当，可是二少非常坚持。
他看瑞儿小姐应该不是不讲理的人，如果她去劝二少打消这个念头，也许这件
事就能圆满落幕。
“什么事？”
“呃，呃，呃……”左金突然犹豫起来，如果瑞儿小姐此时去，二少一定知道是他来密报的，不管二少最后会不会打消念头，他一定都会被烤成人干，不妥，不妥，要三思。
“呃你的头啦！”夏春静踢他一腿。“快滚啦你！”
“喔，好，那……那我回去了。”虽然被踢一脚很痛，但左金还是很感谢，因为他决定闭嘴，夏春静一踢，正好“护送”他离开，不用再向瑞儿小姐解释他欲言又止想说些什么。
奇怪，左金到底要跟她说什么？要说不说的，怎么就走了？巴瑞儿满腹疑问，目光一对上一旁捧着餐盒吃得津津有味的小女人，瞬间升起，肚子火。
那餐点虽然不是掌尚仁亲自买回来的，但他还是特地叫左金买晚餐回来给夏春静吃，而原本要给她吃的那，份晚餐，只是托夏小姐的福，顺便买回来的。
“好好吃喔，好幸福喔，这一盒满满都是尚仁哥的爱心耶？”
吃吧，吃死你、吃撑你、肥死你！
眼不见为净，巴瑞儿再度走回房间，满腹怒火之余，心中有着小小悲哀，他并没有想到她，她打电话给他，他连问她晚餐吃了没都没问，更遑论特地买晚餐回来给她吃，还是等到夏春静跟他撒娇，他才叫左金顺便买她的份。
她在意的不是晚餐，而是在他心中似乎比较在乎夏春静，也许他们相处的时间比较久，但是……但是她对他的爱，绝不会比夏春静少！

可是他呢？他对她的爱，有比对夏春静多吗？
苦笑着，很可悲，她巴瑞儿居然在帮自己爱的男人衡量他对哪个女人的爱多一点。以往，照她的个性，若发现男友有二心，一定马上分手，绝不宽贷。
知道夏春静的事后，她还不走，不是她的个性变了，而是她真的很爱尚仁，愿意等最后的结果，再决定离开或是留下。
可此刻，她怀疑自己依旧对他保有信心，甘心等到最后……
第10章(1)
在公司历经两次大战后，战败的掌尚仁拖着疲惫的身子回到豪宅公寓，手中还拎了一袋新鲜虾子和扇贝。
他爱吃海鲜，在被大哥和父亲联手砍得元气大伤后，更想吃海鲜来补足元气，提振精神。
两天没阖眼，他累得快睁不开眼，方才还是左金载他回来的。
“瑞儿，我好想你。”
在客厅没见到她，进房看到她着睡衣躺在床上，累毙的他，精神一振，马上如恶虎扑羊般朝床上的人扑去——砰！
床上的美人儿侧身翻转，害他硬生生扑了个空，还好床是软的，要不，他全身骨头肯定折损一半。
“瑞儿，你生气了？”两个晚上没见到他，她一定很寂寞，孤枕难眠，睡不好，精神差，脾气自然也差，所以她生气是应该的。
他没告诉她，他为了她的手工包设柜一事，这两天在公司和父亲及大哥展开越洋视讯大战，因为担心结果不若他预期的，会令她失望，但倘若结果如他所愿，到时就给她一个大惊喜。
偏偏这时候公司的事又多如牛毛，他又不像牛有四个胃，可以把所有事一次消化掉，心力交瘁，他累得一步都离不开，公事又不能放着不管，索性就待在办公室，一边处理公事，偶尔抬头和父亲对骂几句，又偶尔和大哥激辩，然后偶尔和母亲撒娇、抱怨一下。
这两天，就算不用处理公事，光被父亲、大哥，加上母亲偶尔也来凑一脚，三人联合起来对他的疲劳轰炸，就够他受的了。
最后，还是大哥的一句好言相劝——别让巴瑞儿还未进门，就得罪了未来公公——才软化他的坚持。
不管大哥是好意，还是用计劝退，为了不让父亲对瑞儿有坏印象，他只好举白旗投降。
但不管能不能设柜，他还是坚持推出以瑞儿为名的手工包精品品牌。这两天除了公事，他还在忙这个，简直忙翻了。
坐起身，背对他坐在床沿，闷了好半晌，巴瑞儿终于出声，“你最好先解决夏春静的事。”
她简直不敢相信自己深爱的男人是只缩头乌龟，夏春静来这里住两天，两天来他居然躲在公司不敢回来！

“喔，拜托，饶了我，我很累，我现在不想谈那只小恶魔的事。”
“你……”回头，见他一脸累垮的模样，她居然感到心疼。
看来，这两天他没回来面对两个女人，日子也不怎么好过，瞧他一脸疲惫样，好像好几天没睡，该不会是在烦恼怎么解决她们的事，才会……
content_en:
"Hou, the fox's tail is exposed, you are the second young lady who wants to be the head of the house!"
"That's why I want to marry Shangren because I love him." A sweet smile appeared on the corner of her mouth. She loves him and naturally wants to marry him. Is this weird? Why are you making such a fuss when you find something to do?
"You love his money! You are such a scheming woman!"
"The money you and he get should be more than me, right?" Why didn't you reflect on yourself before talking about others?
"Uh, I~I'm different."
Stutter! Huh, when I saw her, I thought of the playboy Zhang Shangren, and Barrier was so angry that she almost went crazy.
She got up, strode back to her room, closed the door, and suddenly felt that it was ridiculous. A playboy left his two women in the same room. The two tried their best to be childish and compare themselves to each other, but the man who "caused the trouble" hid in the company and did not dare to come back... Maybe he used business as an excuse to sneak to the nightclub to party again.
It is tolerable, but what is intolerable?
She couldn't bear it anymore!
Just as he was about to call Zhang Shangren and ask him to come back quickly to resolve "family matters", suddenly the doorbell rang.
The first thing that popped into her mind was that he was back! Did he buy dinner for Xia Chunjing? !
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Barrier stared at the door and took a deep breath. She would open the door and go out later. If he came back, she would leave immediately without saying a word.
She opened the door forcefully and walked angrily to the living room. He was not the person in the living room, and half of the anger in her heart was gone.
"Zuo Jin?"
"Miss Ruier, you... you haven't had dinner yet. I bought two portions, and this one is for..." Zuo Jin smiled awkwardly, picked up another dinner on the table and was about to hand it to Barrier, when Xia Chunjing hurriedly grabbed the portion from mid-air.
"This is what I want to eat too."
"But, you are already eating..."
"I have to eat two portions to feel full." Xia Chunjing raised her chin proudly. "Brother Shang Ren knows that I eat a lot without getting fat, so he always buys me meals for two people."
"Oh." Zuo Jin was stunned for a moment. "Then, Miss Ruier, I will buy dinner for you."
"No need." "No need." The two women said in unison.
Barrier glared at Xia Chunjing. It was a misfortune to have a tacit understanding with this woman. This reminded her that they had chosen the same man, and she would rather not have this kind of tacit understanding.
"Uh..." Zuo Jin seemed to smell a strong smell of gunpowder.
"I don't want to eat." Barrier said calmly, she was too lazy to fight anymore.
"Yes, she doesn't want to eat, and didn't you say that the company still has something to do? Go back quickly!"
Yes, the Second Young Master is engaged in a cross-oceanic connection battle with the CEO and the old CEO. He is very angry. If he finds out that his special assistant has temporarily escaped, the fire may burn him to death.
"Uh, Miss Ruier, um..." Zuo Jin hesitated.
The second young master argued with the two adults about setting up a counter for Miss Ruier's handmade bags in Tianxin. In fact, no one was optimistic about the second young master's proposal. Even his special assistant felt that it was not appropriate to kick out the German brand's plan to sell handmade bags, but the second young master was very insistent.
He thought that Miss Ruier was not an unreasonable person. If she persuaded the second young master to give up this idea, maybe this matter would be solved.
Things will end successfully.
"What's the matter?"
"Uh, uh, uh..." Zuo Jin suddenly hesitated. If Miss Rui'er goes at this time, the Second Young Master must know that he is the one who came to report. No matter whether the Second Young Master will give up the idea in the end, he will definitely be roasted and fucked. It's not appropriate, it's not appropriate, you have to think twice.
"Uh, it's your head!" Xia Chunjing kicked him. "Get out of here!"
"Oh, okay, then... then I'll go back." Although the kick hurt, Zuo Jin was still very grateful because he decided to shut up, and Xia Chunjing's kick just happened to "escort" him away, without having to explain his desire to Miss Ruier.He stopped talking and wanted to say something.
Strange, what on earth did Zuo Jin want to tell her? Why did you leave if you wanted to say it or not? Barrier was full of questions. When his eyes met the little woman holding a lunch box and eating with gusto, he instantly felt angry.
Although Zhang Shangren didn't buy the meal himself, he still asked Zuo Jin to buy dinner for Xia Chunjing. The dinner that was originally meant for her was just a blessing from Miss Tuo Xia, so he bought it back by the way.
"It's so delicious, so happy. This box is full of love from Brother Shang Ren, isn't it?"
Eat it, eat it to death, fill you up, fatten you to death!
Out of sight, out of mind, Barrier walked back to the room again, filled with anger and a little sadness in his heart. He didn't think of her. She called him, but he didn't even ask her if she had eaten dinner, let alone bought dinner for her, or waited until Xia Chunjing acted coquettishly with him before he asked Zuo Jin to buy her share.
What she cares about is not the dinner, but he seems to care more about Xia Chunjing in his heart. Maybe they have been together for a longer time, but... But her love for him will never be less than Xia Chunjing!
But what about him? Does he love her more than he loves Xia Chunjing?
Smiling bitterly, it was very sad that she, Barrier, was actually helping the man she loved to measure which woman he loved more. In the past, according to her personality, if she found out that her boyfriend had second thoughts, she would break up with him immediately and never give him any leniency.
After learning about Xia Chunjing, she still didn't leave. It wasn't that her personality had changed, but that she really loved Shang Ren and was willing to wait for the final result before deciding to leave or stay.
But at this moment, she suspected that she still had faith in him and was willing to wait until the end...
Chapter 10(1)
After two wars in the company, the defeated Zhang Shangren dragged his tired body back to the mansion apartment, carrying a bag of fresh shrimps and scallops in his hand.
He loves to eat seafood. After his eldest brother and his father jointly attacked him and severely damaged his vitality, he wanted to eat seafood to replenish his vitality and boost his spirit.
He hadn't closed his eyes for two days, and he was so tired that he could hardly keep them open. Zuo Jin had just brought him back.
"Ruier, I miss you so much."
He didn't see her in the living room, but when he entered the room he saw her lying on the bed in pajamas. He was so exhausted that he cheered up and immediately pounced on the person on the bed like a tiger pounces on a sheep - bang!
The beauty on the bed turned sideways, causing him to jump into the air. Fortunately, the bed was soft, otherwise, half of his bones would have been broken.
"Rui'er, are you angry?" She must have been lonely after not seeing him for two nights. She couldn't sleep well, her energy was low, and her temper was naturally bad, so it was right for her to be angry.
He didn't tell her that he had been having a cross-ocean video battle with his father and eldest brother in the company for the past two days to set up a cabinet for her handmade bags, because he was worried that the result would not be as he expected and would disappoint her, but if the result was as he expected, he would give her a big surprise.
Unfortunately, there were so many things going on in the company at this time, and unlike a cow with four stomachs, he could digest everything at once. He was exhausted mentally and physically. He was so tired that he couldn't leave, and he couldn't leave the business alone, so he simply stayed in the office, handling business while occasionally raising his head to scold his father, occasionally arguing with his eldest brother, and occasionally acting coquettishly and complaining to his mother.
In the past two days, even if he didn't have to deal with official matters, it was enough for him to bear the fatigue bombardment from his father, eldest brother, and mother who occasionally came to join in. The three of them combined to attack him.
In the end, it was his elder brother's kind words - don't let Barry offend his future father-in-law before he even entered the door - that softened his persistence.
Regardless of whether the eldest brother had good intentions or was trying to persuade him to quit, in order to prevent his father from having a bad impression of Rui'er, he had no choice but to raise the white flag and surrender.
But regardless of whether he can set up a counter or not, he still insists on launching a boutique brand of handmade bags named Ruier. In addition to official business these past two days, he has also been busy with this, which is extremely busy.
Sit up and sit on the edge of the bed with your back to him.After being bored for a long time, Barrier finally said, "You'd better resolve Xia Chunjing's matter first."
She couldn't believe that the man she loved so much was a coward. Xia Chunjing came here to stay for two days, and for the past two days, he actually hid in the company and didn't dare to come back!
"Oh, please, spare me, I'm tired and I don't want to talk about that little devil right now."
"You..." Looking back, she actually felt distressed when she saw the tired look on his face.
It seems that he has not been back to face the two women in the past two days, and his life has not been easy. He looks tired, as if he has not slept for several days. Is he worried about how to solve their problems?
